title: Purification of Affinity Tag-free Recombinant Tubulin from Insect Cells
protocol: Transform 3 μL of a pFastBac Dual donor plasmid (∼500 ng/μL) that encodes the codon-optimized α- and β-tubulin genes into 100 μL of DH10Bac competent cells.
Plate the transformed cells onto DH10Bac LB agar plates.
Incubate the plate at 37°C for 1 day.
Pick one white colony to streak onto another DH10Bac LB agar plate.
Incubate the new plate at 37°C for 1 day.
Inoculate 6 mL of LB medium containing 50 μg/mL kanamycin, 7 μg/mL gentamicin, and 10 μg/mL tetracycline with cells from step 2.
Incubate the culture at 37°C and 230 rpm orbital rotation for about 18 h.
Harvest the cells from Step 3 at 4,000 rcf for 10 min at 4°C.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 250 μL of P1 buffer.
Transfer the cells to a new 1.7 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Add 250 μL of P2 buffer into the cell suspension and mix by inverting the tube 4-6 times.
Add 350 μL of N3 buffer into the cell suspension and mix by inverting the tube 4-6 times.
Centrifuge the cell lysate at 21,000 rcf for 10 min at room temperature.
Transfer the supernatant to a 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Add 1 mL of phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1, v/v).
Invert the tube 4-6 times to mix.
Centrifuge at 21,000 rcf for 2 min at room temperature.
Transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Repeat Step 9 to 11 twice.
Add 1 mL of anhydrous chloroform to the final aqueous phase.
Invert the tube 4-6 times to mix.
Centrifuge at 21,000 rcf for 2 min at room temperature.
Transfer the final aqueous phase (∼750 μl) to a 15 mL conical centrifuge tube.
Add 10% volume of 8 M lithium chloride to the tube.
Tap the bottom of the tube to mix.
Add 2.5 mL of 100% ethanol to the mixture.
Incubate on ice for 20 min.
Centrifuge at 4,000 rcf for 20 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant from the tube.
Gently resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of ice-cold 80% (v/v) ethanol.
Transfer the solution to a new 1.7 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 21,000 rcf for 10 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant from the microcentrifuge tubes.
Air dry the purified bacmid pellet at room temperature for at least 30 min.
Cover the microcentrifuge tubes with a sheet of plastic wrap to minimize airborne contamination.
Dissolve the dried pellet in 50 μL sterile Milli-Q water.
Plate 9x10^5 Sf9 cells into two 9.5 cm² flat-bottom wells of a 6-well plate.
Incubate the cells at 27°C for 1 hour to allow cell attachment.
Dilute 12 μg of purified bacmid DNA into 200 μl of serum- and antibiotic-free Sf-900 II medium in a sterilized microcentrifuge tube.
Mix Cellfectin II Reagent by inverting the stock tube 6 times.
Dilute 12 μl of Cellfectin II into 200 μl of serum- and antibiotic-free Sf-900 II medium.
Combine the diluted bacmid and Cellfectin II reagent.
Mix gently by tapping the microcentrifuge tube.
Incubate at room temperature for 45 min.
Aspirate the medium from Sf9 cells.
Rinse each well with 2 ml of serum- and antibiotic-free Sf-900 II medium.
Add 0.8 ml of serum- and antibiotic-free Sf-900 II medium per well.
Add the bacmid:Cellfectin II mixture (∼206 μl per well) to the attached Sf9 cells.
Incubate at 27°C for 5 h.
Aspirate the medium.
Add 2 ml of Sf-900 II medium supplemented with 10% (v/v) FBS and 1% (v/v) Antibiotic-Antimycotic per well.
Incubate at 27°C for 72 h.
Resuspend the cells with a 5 ml serological pipette.
Combine the cell culture from both wells to a 15 ml conical centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 1,000 rcf for 5 min at room temperature.
Filter the supernatant through a sterilized 25 mm diameter syringe filter with a 0.45 μm pore size polyethersulfone membrane into another 15 ml conical centrifuge tube.
Plate 9x10^6 Sf9 cells into a 75 cm^2 vented cap tissue culture flask.
Incubate at 27°C for 1 h to allow cell attachment.
Replace medium with 23 mL of Sf-900 II medium supplemented with 10% (v/v) FBS and 1% (v/v) Antibiotic-Antimycotic.
Add 2 mL of the P1 virus.
Incubate at 27°C for 60 hours.
Resuspend cells using a 10 mL serological pipette.
Transfer cell culture to a 50 mL conical centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 1,000 rcf for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Filter the supernatant through a sterilized 25 mm diameter syringe filter with a 0.45 μm pore size polyethersulfone membrane into another 50 mL conical centrifuge tube.
Wrap the 50 mL conical centrifuge tube with aluminum foil.
Store virus stock at 4°C and protect from light for up to 2 years if needed.
Generate P3 Virus
Plate 9x10^6 Sf9 cells into a 75 cm² vented cap tissue culture flask.
Incubate at 27°C for 1 hour to allow cell attachment.
Aspirate the medium, add 1 mL of P2 virus and 24 mL of Sf-900 II medium supplemented with 10% (v/v) FBS and 1% (v/v) Antibiotic-Antimycotic.
Incubate at 27°C for 60 hours.
Resuspend cells using a 10 mL serological pipette.
Transfer cell culture to a 50 mL conical centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 1,000 rcf for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Filter the supernatant through a sterilized 25 mm diameter syringe filter with a 0.45 μm pore size polyethersulfone membrane into another 50 mL conical centrifuge tube.
This is the P3 virus stock.
Wrap the 50 mL conical centrifuge tube with a sheet of aluminum foil.
Store the virus stock at 4°C and protected from light.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 1 mL of lysis buffer.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 1.7 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Incubate on ice for 20 min.
Centrifuge the cell lysate at 21,000 rcf for 10 min at 4°C.
Use 15 μL of sample to run a western blot analysis using primary antibodies against α- or β-tubulin.
Infect High Five cells with P3 virus when the cell density is at 2.5∼3.5x106 cells/mL, adding 6 mL of P3 virus per 600 mL of cell culture.
Incubate infected insect cell culture at 27°C and 110 rpm orbital rotation for 60 h.
Harvest cells by centrifugation at 1,000 rcf for 10 min at 4°C.
Perform all steps in a cold room or on ice.
Pre-chill the buffers, glass containers, plastic tubes, pipettes, filters, and syringes in a cold room or on ice.
Add 5 μL of 25 U/μL benzonase and 2 tablets of Roche complete EDTA-free protease inhibitor to 40 mL of lysis buffer.
Resuspend the cell pellet with the lysis buffer supplemented with benzonase and protease inhibitor using a 10 mL serological pipette.
Lyse cells by 20 strokes of dounce homogenization on ice.
Centrifuge the homogenized cell lysate at 55,000 rpm (∼222,000 rcf) for 1 hour at 4°C in a Type 70 Ti rotor.
Collect the supernatant with a 10 mL serological pipette, avoiding the bottom 25% of the supernatant.
Centrifuge the turbid bottom fraction of the supernatant at 21,000 rcf for 10 minutes at 4°C and pool this supernatant with the rest from step 43.
Filter the supernatant through 33 mm diameter syringe filters with a 0.22 μm pore size polyethersulfone membrane using a 10 mL syringe.
Optional: Take 20 μl of sample for SDS-PAGE and western blot analysis.
Equilibrate two 1 mL HisTrap HP columns connected in series with 4 mL of lysis buffer at 1 mL/min.
Load the 0.22 μm filtered cell lysate onto the columns at 1 mL/min (e.g., using a Superloop).
Take 20 μl of sample from the flow-through for SDS-PAGE and western blot analysis.
Wash the columns with at least 35 mL of lysis buffer until UV absorption (A280) reaches baseline.
Elute with HisTrap elution buffer at 1 mL/min in 0.25 mL fractions.
Collect the fractions in a multi-well microplate.
Leave pump A with the lysis buffer while pumping the HisTrap elution buffer through pump B to minimize buffer consumption.
Elute the two columns separately.
Detach the second column and elute the first column until baseline.
Attach the second column and continue eluting until baseline.
Dilute the HisTrap eluate by approximately 3-fold using lysis buffer.
Limit the volume of the diluted protein solution to no more than 30 mL.
Equilibrate two 1 mL StrepTrap HP columns connected in series with 4 mL of equilibration buffer containing 66% lysis buffer and 34% HisTrap elution buffer at 1 mL/min.
Filter the diluted HisTrap eluate through a 33 mm diameter/0.22 μm pore size syringe polyethersulfone membrane filter.
Load the filtered protein solution onto the equilibrated StrepTrap HP columns using a Superloop at 1 mL/min.
Optionally, take 20 μL of sample from the flow-through for SDS-PAGE and western blot analysis.
Wash the columns with 4 mL of buffer containing 66% lysis buffer and 34% HisTrap elution buffer at 1 mL/min.
Perform a pump wash to prime pump B before changing the wash buffer.
Wash the columns with 25 mL of strep wash buffer A followed by 25 mL of strep wash buffer B at 1 mL/min.
Wash the columns with 10 mL of lysis buffer to remove baseline nucleotide signal at 1 mL/min.
Elute with strep elution buffer at 0.8 mL/min in 0.25 mL fractions.
Collect fractions in a multi-well microplate.
Optional: Elute the two columns separately.
Detach the second column and elute the first column until baseline.
Attach the second column and continue the elution until baseline.
Take 20 μL of sample from the eluate for SDS-PAGE and western blot analysis.
Pool all fractions with an A280 value above the baseline into a chilled 50 mL conical centrifuge tube.
Use approximately 300 μL of strep elution buffer to rinse out the wells of the collection plate.
Dilute the eluate to approximately 25 mL with strep elution buffer.
Dilute ∼4 mg TEV into 5 mL of strep elution buffer.
Add the diluted TEV solution to the eluate from Step 59.
Incubate on ice for 2 h.
Mix gently every 10 min by inverting the tube 4-6 times.
Take 20 μl of sample for SDS-PAGE and western blot analysis.
Centrifuge the digested protein at 4,000 rcf for 30 sec to bring all the liquid to the bottom of the tube.
Equilibrate two 1 mL HiTrap SP columns connected in series with 5 mL of Strep elution buffer at 1 mL/min.
Filter the digested protein through a 33 mm diameter/0.22 μm pore size syringe polyethersulfone membrane filter.
Load the filtered protein solution onto the equilibrated HiTrap SP/HisTrap HP columns at 1 mL/min using a Superloop.
Collect the flow-through immediately, which contains the recombinant tubulin.
Flow and collect another 10 mL of strep elution buffer through the columns to maximize protein recovery.
Take 20 μl of sample from the flow-through for SDS-PAGE and western blot analysis.
Equilibrate a Superdex 200 HiLoad 16/60 column with 130 mL of gel filtration buffer at 1 mL/min.
Pre-equilibrate a 15 mL 50 kDa MWCO centrifugal filter unit with ice-cold gel filtration buffer.
Concentrate the flow-through to less than 3 mL.
Load the concentrated protein solution onto the equilibrated Superdex 200 HiLoad 16/60 column at 1 mL/min.
Keep flowing the gel filtration buffer through the column at 1 mL/min for one column volume.
Pool all fractions with an A280 value above baseline into a 50 mL conical centrifuge tube.
Take 20 μl of sample from the eluate for SDS-PAGE and western blot analysis.
Concentrate the gel filtration eluate to less than 1 mL using another pre-equilibrated filter unit in ice-cold buffer.
Take 1-5 μl sample for SDS-PAGE analysis to determine purity.
Measure protein concentration by Bradford assay or absorption at 280 nm.
Snap freeze small aliquots (∼20 μl) of concentrated protein in liquid nitrogen.
Store snap-frozen aliquots at -80°C.
